query: What additive manufacturing strategy and post-processing route can enable the fabrication of a refractory high-entropy alloy family (Group IV-V transition metals) capable of retaining high-temperature structural integrity, and what specific microstructural state is hypothesized to optimize mechanical performance while mitigating the inherent brittleness associated with interstitial impurities?

generation.hypothesis: The fabrication of refractory high-entropy alloys (RHEAs) with a single body-centered cubic (BCC) solid solution microstructure via selective laser melting (SLM) can enable the retention of high-temperature structural integrity, and the specific microstructural state of a fine-grained, low-oxygen content alloy with a homogeneous distribution of elements is hypothesized to optimize mechanical performance while mitigating inherent brittleness.
generation.material_initial_state: Refractory high-entropy alloy (RHEA) with a composition of NbMoTaWVCr
generation.intervention: Selective laser melting (SLM) with a linear energy density of up to 2.83 J/mm
generation.conditions: High-temperature environment, low oxygen content, and homogeneous distribution of elements
generation.structural_mediator: Fine-grained microstructure with a grain size of 1.24 µm
generation.mechanism: Formation of an interstitial solid solution in the matrix and refinement of the microstructure through SLM processing
generation.predicted_outcome: Improved mechanical properties, including high yield strength and plasticity, at room and elevated temperatures
generation.boundary: Limited by the inherent brittleness of RHEAs and the challenges of processing refractory alloys
generation.uncertainty: The exact relationship between the microstructural state and mechanical performance is not fully understood, and further research is needed to optimize the processing conditions and alloy composition

falsification_experiment.design: Comparison of the mechanical properties of RHEAs fabricated via SLM and traditional processing methods
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If the SLM-processed RHEAs do not exhibit improved mechanical properties compared to traditionally processed RHEAs, the hypothesis is falsified.
